item.title: A Sandboxed AI Ops Bot for the Homelab
item.description: Installing Hermes Agent — a self-hosted, chat app reachable AI ops assistant — on the homelab node via Ansible, then taking away almost everything it could do wrong: a trimmed-down toolset, a rootless Podman sandbox for command execution, and a dedicated Kubernetes identity.

item.title: Building a Production-Grade Homelab with Kubernetes, GitOps, and Zero-Trust Security
item.description: How to build a production-grade homelab with full OIDC-secured application stack using GitOps and zero-trust principles.
